title: Function gate
statement: For natural numbers $f_{\mathrm{base}}$, $z_{\mathrm{base}}$, $k$, and $t$, define a gate of type OR. If $t=0$, it has no input vertices; otherwise its inputs are $f_{\mathrm{base}}+\max(t-2^{\lfloor\log_2 t\rfloor},0)$ and $z_{\mathrm{base}}+\max(2^k+\lfloor\log_2 t\rfloor-1,0)$.
